scope: Shared checked CPU int64/uint64 reduceSum, exact adjacent-pair trees, eight-byte scratch storage and structured worker scalar results/recovery.

semantics.tree: Row-major traversal, checked adjacent-pair sums, unchanged odd tail, repeated until one result. Rank zero supported; empty input yields exact typed zero. No widened-total accumulator, wrapping, saturation or reassociation.
semantics.arithmetic: Common reduction/tree lowering reuses checked scalar integer addition: signed64 adds in signed i128 and checks bounds; unsigned64 adds in unsigned i128 and checks UINT64_MAX before narrowing each pair. Existing float32/32-bit paths unchanged.
semantics.storage: Ranked input descriptor and scratch guards enforce INT64_MAX/8 before reads/allocations. Scratch cells and empty zero use actual numeric width. Empty metadata with huge unused extent remains valid. No runtime allocator/storage changes.
semantics.tasks: Existing tensor captures, scalar outcomes, nested workers and repeated awaits. Arithmetic failures retain reduction source 2:3 and no successful scalar; recovery reuses immutable parent data in a fresh group.
semantics.failure: Ranked native harness checks scratch allocation rejection, cooperative cancellation and zero live owners. CLI allocation injection positions 1..24 accept root-bridge AllocationFault or admitted TaskError.Fault, with live=0 cleanup; successful entries check live invocation allocations before printing exact values.
semantics.remaining: 64-bit matmul remains gated in source and backend. Metal integer arithmetic, further formats/conversions, public foreign-memory/wire ABI and distributed execution remain separate work.

coverage: Shared 32/64-bit harness with independent per-pair signed128/unsigned128 references for 64-bit inputs
Ranks 0..3, exact endpoints and above-2^53 cells, empty axes, odd/multilevel trees and first/later-level overflow
1200 deterministic shapes/contents per nonzero rank, alternating small/full-width cells
Padded/strided offset views, input immutability, negative extents, byte limit immediately above INT64_MAX/8, and huge unused extent in valid empty descriptors
Scratch allocation rejection, cancellation sender handshake and bounded workload retries only if execution completes before observing the signal
Nested/cached worker reductions, exact unsigned maximum and signed minimum CLI results, signed tree-order example and Arithmetic recovery with original parent tensors
Synchronous and worker reduction faults preserve source 2:3; worker failures report zero-live cleanup
Allocation injection positions 1..24 at 1/2/4 workers, native root setup versus admitted-task failure distinction
Frontend typing independently sanitized; mismatched signedness reduction IR rejected by backend; matmul/Metal admission gates retained
Existing 32-bit reduction suites rerun through the shared driver/harness in all four variants
qualification.gpu_shader_sanitizers: Host ASan/UBSan and TSan do not instrument Metal shaders.

regression.resolved: The pre-existing uint32 tensor cancellation sender could start after the optimized kernel completed. The same compiled executable passed on immediate rerun; its LLVM and harness source matched prior qualification hashes. Only that test harness was changed after the full run, adding the established thread-ready handshake and bounded larger-workload retries. Other faults are not retried.

performance: No performance claim or benchmark in this milestone.
distributed_execution: Not implemented; agreed design discussion remains a prerequisite.
